description: This Java class 'AttributesReadRequest' handles reading attributes from a Zigbee device cluster. It constructs a request to read specified attributes, optionally with manufacturer ID, and sends a response.

classes.name: AttributesReadRequest
classes.description: Handles the request to read specific attributes from a Zigbee device's cluster, including remote execution and response generation.

methods.name: AttributesReadRequest
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the request with device-specific parameters and attribute IDs.

methods.name: executeDeviceRequest
methods.description: Executes the attribute read request on the specified device, retrieving attribute data and sending responses.
